name: Goorambat East Solar Farm (ENGIE)
notable: First power injected early Nov 2025 per Renewables Now. Full production targeted 2026, transmission complete Sep 2026. ENGIE 250 MW VIC solar.

timeline.title: COD estimate updated
timeline.detail: COD changed from 2026-05 to 2026-05-18 (source: AEMO Generation Information)

eis_specs.document_title: Goorambat East Solar Farm – Town Planning Report, Neoen Australia Pty Ltd (AECOM, 16 August 2019)
eis_specs.connection_substation_name: New Goorambat East Terminal Station on existing 220 kV Shepparton TS – Dederang TS line
eis_specs.connection_augmentation: New 220/33 kV project terminal substation with three 220 kV switchyard bays (approx. 100 x 50 m footprint) tapping into the Shepparton–Dederang 220 kV overhead line within the site
eis_specs.notes: Originally developed by Neoen Australia Pty Ltd; acquired by ENGIE in 2023. Up to 250 MW AC via ~500,000 bifacial 380 W PV modules on single-axis trackers (tracker rotation ±60°, max 4 m height) and up to ~120 inverters. 630 ha across 5 rural properties in Benalla RCC, ~215 km NE of Melbourne. Approved December 2019 by Benalla Rural City Council. Construction commenced late 2024; commissioning targeted 2027.
